description: Central catalog of UI texture and sprite asset names for each character variation: character-select icons, cut-ins, battle face-icon sets, ranking/out-game images and command-list portraits.

ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export), typically a variation ID (CP_xxx_yy). GameCharacter_FindImageRow(Id, bLookUpCharacter) resolves a Character ID via its first variation, or takes a variation ID directly, then finds this row using Variation->Id_CharacterImage across CharacterImageDataTables (DTM +0x480).

CharacterSelectIconFileName.technical: FName (row +0x10), e.g. T_UI_Character_CharacterSelect_Icon_Square_CP_010_00. Loaded/resolved via WidgetManager's WidgetTextureLoaders by the character-select list item and the visual-lobby top widget; also included in widget-texture preload lists for selection screens.

CharacterSelectVerticalIconFileName.technical: FName (row +0x18); dynamically loaded for replay/collection items and collected into texture preload lists by MainMenuCollection. Exported rows can set this to None when no vertical art exists.

CutInImageFileName.technical: FName (row +0x20). Battle cut-in widget falls back to this when a BattleTalk row has no BattleTalkImageFileName, and lobby/battle setup preloads it. BattleStory preload also collects it from variations.

CornerCutInImageChanceFileName.simple: Sprite sheet for the player-team/chance corner cut-in.
CornerCutInImageChanceFileName.technical: FName (row +0x28), dynamically loaded as a UPaperSprite by the battle corner cut-in widget when bPlayerTeam is true; its Slate atlas data drives the cut-in material. Also preloaded by BattleCharacterAssetCollectors::BattleAssets_WidgetSprites_12BD370.

CornerCutInImagePinchFileName.simple: Sprite sheet for the enemy-team/pinch corner cut-in.
CornerCutInImagePinchFileName.technical: FName (row +0x30), selected by the corner cut-in widget when bPlayerTeam is false; same sprite-atlas material path and preload as the chance variant.

BattleTalkImageFileName.simple: Portrait texture used for battle-talk/symbol-chat messages.
BattleTalkImageFileName.technical: FName (row +0x38). GameBattleTalkWidget prefers the BattleTalk row's own BattleTalkImageFileName and falls back to this field. BattleStory preload collects it, and the preloaded texture is used in talk/cut-in display.

BattleCharacterIconNormalFileName.simple: Base name of the normal battle face-icon sprite.
BattleCharacterIconNormalFileName.technical: FName; AGameWidgetManager::GetCharacterFaceIconSpriteName selects this base for EGameWidgetCharacterFaceIconType::Normal (and the default case) and appends a size suffix such as _Sprite or _VerySmall_Sprite. Missing row or None name produces an empty FName.

BattleCharacterIconAttackFileName.simple: Base name of the attack-state battle face-icon sprite.
BattleCharacterIconAttackFileName.technical: FName selected for EGameWidgetCharacterFaceIconType::Attack in GetCharacterFaceIconSpriteName; the same size suffix is appended. Some rows reuse the normal sprite name for this state.

BattleCharacterIconDamageFileName.simple: Base name of the damage-state battle face-icon sprite.
BattleCharacterIconDamageFileName.technical: FName selected for EGameWidgetCharacterFaceIconType::Damage in GetCharacterFaceIconSpriteName and suffixed by icon size.

BattleCharacterIconPinchFileName.simple: Base name of the pinch/low-HP battle face-icon sprite.
BattleCharacterIconPinchFileName.technical: FName selected for EGameWidgetCharacterFaceIconType::Pinch in GetCharacterFaceIconSpriteName and suffixed by icon size.

BattleCharacterIconCursedEnergyMaxFileNa.simple: Base name of the max-cursed-energy battle face-icon sprite.
BattleCharacterIconCursedEnergyMaxFileNa.technical: FName selected for EGameWidgetCharacterFaceIconType::CursedEnergyMax in GetCharacterFaceIconSpriteName; also the sprite name used by UI effects tied to max cursed energy.

RankingFilterIconFileName.simple: Icon texture for filtering ranking lists by character.
RankingFilterIconFileName.technical: FName (row +0x68), dynamically loaded by the ranking filter list item and also collected into PvE/PvP menu texture preload lists. None means no filter icon.

OutGameImageFileName.simple: Portrait/character image used outside battle (menus, customize, VS settings).
OutGameImageFileName.technical: FName (row +0x70). Dynamically loaded by command-list, VS-enemy interval/settings and other out-game widgets; added to preload lists by battle/interval/free-battle/story setup. Sometimes paired with the previous/next character's image for transitions.

OutGameBackgroundImageFileName.simple: Background art paired with the out-game character image.
OutGameBackgroundImageFileName.technical: FName (row +0x78); VS-enemy character settings passes the current/previous/next characters' values together with their OutGameImageFileName values into the character-switch display so background art swaps with the portrait.

OutGameFaceIconFileName.simple: Base name of the out-game face icon texture.
OutGameFaceIconFileName.technical: FName; GameWidget_GetOutGameFaceIconName appends a size suffix ('' / _Small / _VerySmall / _Tiny / _VeryTiny); the Icon enum argument is read in retail but all icon kinds resolve to the same base name. None short-circuits to an empty FName. Dynamically loaded via GameWidget_GetOutGameFaceIconTexture by character ID.

CommandListIconFileName.simple: Portrait icon used in command lists, arcade root info and result/story lists.
CommandListIconFileName.technical: FName (row +0x88). Dynamically loaded by command list, arcade mission info, battle situation overview, result player list, story relation/reward widgets; preloaded by battle base, interval arcade and main-menu setups. Typically T_UI_Item_Costume- or T_UI_Character_CommandListIcon-style names.

notes: Export contains 48 rows, keyed by variation ID; CharacterVariation::Id_CharacterImage selects the row, so alternate costumes can point at a shared image row.
Most fields are plain FName asset keys, not loaded UObject references; resolution goes through WidgetManager texture/sprite loaders or dynamic-load maps, and many rows use None for unused art slots.
No localization variants exist for this table; the same texture keys are used in all languages. No claim about Blueprint-only consumers or assets absent from the partial Content export.
Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; no claim of byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: GameCharacter_FindImageRow resolves the row from a character or variation ID.
Battle face-icon sprite names are built from the five BattleCharacterIcon* base names plus a size suffix.
Cut-in and corner-cut-in textures are gathered into battle preload lists.
Out-game image and command-list icon are preloaded for battle.
